title: Tiris
description: A platform for testing and running crypto trading strategies.
highlights: Backtest strategies against historical market data.
Run automated strategies and review positions and performance in the web portal.

title: Upglow
description: An AI daily log that turns everyday notes into searchable records and trends.
highlights: I built Upglow after more than a decade of logging my days in spreadsheets.
The app extracts tags and measurements from free-form entries so users can find past notes and see patterns.

screenshots.alt: A daily log entry with automatically suggested hashtags
screenshots.caption: Automatic hashtags

title: Easygrin Pool
description: A Grin mining pool with public hashrate and reward data.
highlights: Miners can connect their rigs and monitor current and historical hashrate.
Public data shows how mining rewards are distributed.

screenshots.alt: Easygrin Pool homepage with network and pool hashrate metrics
screenshots.caption: Pool homepage

title: Easygrin Wallet
description: An always-online Grin wallet for receiving mining payouts.
highlights: I made this wallet so Grin miners could receive payouts while their local wallet was offline.
Users can forward payouts to another wallet or an exchange.

screenshots.alt: Easygrin Wallet homepage introducing the web wallet for miners
screenshots.caption: Wallet homepage

title: Zytxl
description: A contact directory that helps military veterans reconnect with former unit members.
highlights: Members can create a shared directory, invite former comrades, and search by details such as city or industry.
Administrators can review requests to join and add custom fields for their group.

screenshots.alt: Zytxl directory with contacts grouped by city
screenshots.caption: Browse by city

title: Reindeer
description: An Android VPN client with one-tap connection and a choice of regions.
highlights: One app brings connection controls, server selection, and account management together.
A shared Android codebase supports Reindeer, Ladder, and Xdeer.

title: Wangcard
description: A WeChat Mini Program for learning Chinese characters with cards.
highlights: Learners browse Chinese character cards organized into books.
A cross-platform client delivers the learning experience through a WeChat Mini Program.

title: Tetragram
description: A mobile AR app for placing photos in the physical world.
highlights: Users can leave a virtual photo at a physical location.
A mobile AR view lets people see photos in the places where they were left.
